PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.whatDataContent: We process personal data of apartment owners necessary for building management: full name, email address, phone number, co-ownership share of common areas.
PrivacyPolicy.purposeContent: We process your personal data for the purposes of building management, including organizing votings, maintaining owner records, communication between owners and the manager, and keeping meeting minutes.
PrivacyPolicy.yourRightsContent: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, data portability, and the right to object. You can withdraw your consent at any time in your profile settings.
PrivacyPolicy.retentionContent: We retain personal data for the duration of your apartment ownership and for 5 additional years after it ends, unless a longer archival period is required by law.
PrivacyPolicy.contactContent: For questions regarding personal data processing, please contact the building manager.
